children: California utility said Wednesday they could shut off power for more than 330K homes and businesses due to a heightened risk of wildfires, after the National Weather Service issued a red-flag warning for parts of the state.
With humidity falling fast and Santa Ana winds rising in much of California, "all of this will add up to a high risk for large fires and rapid fire growth over most of the area," the NWS said.
Tuesday it may cut power for ~88K customers in 29 countries across the northern and central part of the state through Saturday, adding 25K customers to a previous forecast.
